_comment: GLM dev-drainer worker providers (issue #4841, ADR-0032 as amended): an ORDERED list of Anthropic-compatible backends. The gate hands the drainer the FIRST provider that is neither quota-blocked nor at its own optional dailyCap. Each `model` is an explicit non-Claude name (the routing fence, issue #3758) and `tokenEnv` NAMES the variable holding the credential in the off-git EnvironmentFile (~/.config/hydra-glm/env) - never a token value. Adding a provider's account/credential is an operator action (ADR-0005); adding it to this list is a config-only change. Override the path with HYDRA_GLM_DRAINER_PROVIDERS_FILE.
